name: bluebutton
description: B&B (BlueButton) - find people to play board games with. KAIST CS350 team project.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
